classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve and analyze representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0036418) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0035597) activities via GO annotation and InterPro family membership; characterize them with biochemical sequence analysis; and rank the representative candidate set using VPA tools only.
assumptions: GO:0035597 is used as the NADPHX epimerase molecular-function GO term; the actual current OBO identifier should be verified against the live GO release before production use.
GO:0036418 is used as the ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydratase molecular-function GO term; confirmed in recent GO releases but should be validated.
IPR007449 (YjeF_N, N-terminal domain) anchors the NnrD/NAXD bacterial NAD(P)HX dehydratase-related family and is the primary InterPro anchor for this workflow.

reviewed=true and exclude_iea=true are applied so that only Swiss-Prot manually curated, experimentally supported entries are retrieved; these are inherently more representative than unreviewed homologs.
No MMseqs2 target database path was supplied; mmseqs2_gpu self-clustering is excluded and representative selection relies on Swiss-Prot curation combined with rank_designs scoring.
sequence_analysis is applied per retrieved FASTA batch to compute per-residue biochemical properties, charge at pH 7.4, regions, and motif annotations.
rank_designs aggregates sequence-analysis records from all three retrieval branches to score and rank candidates; no structural predictions are available in this sequence-only workflow.
Top 20 ranked entries are interpreted as the final representative candidate set.
No taxonomy filter is applied; sequences are retrieved across all organisms to maximise diversity of the representative set.
missing_inputs: MMseqs2-formatted target database path (e.g., a local UniRef50 or UniRef90 index) required for mmseqs2_gpu similarity-based clustering and representative selection; the mmseqs2_gpu node is omitted until this path is provided.
Exact validated GO term IDs for the two enzymatic activities (GO:0035597 for epimerase and GO:0036418 for dehydratase are used tentatively and should be confirmed).
Organism or taxonomic scope preference (none specified; all-taxa retrieval is assumed).

success_criteria.epimerase_sequences_retrieved: go_sequences for GO:0035597 returns at least one reviewed Swiss-Prot entry
success_criteria.dehydratase_sequences_retrieved: go_sequences for GO:0036418 returns at least one reviewed Swiss-Prot entry
success_criteria.interpro_sequences_retrieved: interpro_sequences for IPR007449 returns at least one reviewed Swiss-Prot entry
success_criteria.analyses_complete: sequence_analysis completes without error for each of the three retrieved FASTAs
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_designs returns a ranked list of up to 20 representative NAD(P)HX repair protein sequences with biochemical annotation scores
